title: [Bug][SubscriptionBilling]: Performance: Billing document creation does not scale to large datasets (4M+ subscription lines)
summary: Billing document creation now scales to millions of subscription lines through code optimizations, database indexes, transaction checkpoints, and progress tracking, eliminating redundant lookups and event dispatch overhead.
key_points: New Progress Tracker codeunit gives a reusable, GuiAllowed-guarded ETA dialog that is safe for Job Queue runs
Commit checkpoints added every 10 contracts in billing proposals and per document on the non-posting creation path; per-commitment commit removed in usage data billing
New subscriber codeunit skips redundant unit price and cost calculations when inserting billing document lines
Dictionary-based aggregation, SetLoadFields and IsEmpty checks replace costly loops and lookups
New or extended keys on Billing Line, Subscription Line, Usage Data Billing and Usage Data Generic Import; three event subscribers inlined into hot paths
